login.title: Sign in
login.idle: You were signed out after 30 minutes without activity.
login.ended: Your session was ended. Sign in again.

mfa.title: Second factor
mfa.enrollLead: Scan the code with an authenticator app and enter the six digits it shows.
mfa.verifyLead: Enter the six digits from your authenticator app.
mfa.failed: The code did not match. Try again with a new code.
mfa.enrollFailed: The authenticator could not be set up. Try again, or ask an owner to check your account.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.blocked_ip: Sign-in is not allowed from this network.
mfa.blocked_time: Sign-in is not allowed at this time of day.
mfa.blocked_inactive: This account is not active. Ask an owner to check it.
mfa.blocked_method: This sign-in method is not allowed for your account.
mfa.rememberHint: You are not signed out for inactivity here. Not on a shared or public computer.

denied.title: No access
denied.body: This account is not an administrator of the platform.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.done: You will not get marketing email from {from} any more. Emails about your account still come.
unsubscribe.notFound: This link is not valid any more.
unsubscribe.unavailable: The page could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

welcome.title: Welcome to Sentral
welcome.lead: Choose a password. Next you add two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app.
welcome.badLink: This invitation link is not complete. Open it again from the email, or ask for a new invitation.

problems.invalid: Something in the form was not right. Open the link from the email again.
problems.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
problems.weak: Choose a longer password (at least 12 characters).
problems.expired: The invitation link has expired or was used. Ask for a new invitation.
problems.failed: The password could not be saved. Try again.
